newsitem.title: UK: LME zinc holds gains in evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME zinc holds gains in evening session.

text.p: Zinc prices on the London Metal Exchange edged slightly firmer during Tuesday's evening trade after reaching 6-3/4 year highs on the kerb.
At 1800 GMT zinc was indicated at $1,445/$1,448 against the last trade on the kerb at $1,437 up $9.00. Analysts said the zinc market could expect resistance at $1,450.
Copper was just a few dollars firmer in the late session after kerb dealings were curtailed by nerves ahead of Wednesday's option declaration day.
The red metal was at $2,397/$2,399 and aluminium was also a shade firmer at $1,612/$1,615.
